comparison.objective: Bread all faces of a chicken tender and place it on a fryer rack; candidate services a linear bearing.
comparison.physical_skill: Record presses particulate coating onto food and minimizes subsequent gripping. Candidate performs rigid precision alignment and sliding while containing free balls.
comparison.success_condition: Record grades remaining bare surface and final rack placement. Candidate grades complete transfer, ball retention and avoidance of separation, jam, impact and contamination.
comparison.reason: Coating coverage and grip minimization are unrelated to rail-to-jig bearing transfer.
